verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents netlify.toml (or any single manifest) as a way to declare an entire architecture (functions, redirects, headers, databases, DNS, envs) in one versioned file; the only reference to netlify.toml is a community complaint about unclear docs for its [dev] section (netlify-comm-12), not a confirmation of full-architecture-as-code capability. CLI and REST API docs (netlify-docs-14, netlify-docs-15) show operational tooling but not a single declarative config for the whole stack.
